```{ojs}
IDX = FileAttachment("../data/inst_index.csv").csv({typed: true}).then(a => a.map(d => ({...d, label: d.campuses > 1 ? `${d.name} + ${d.campuses - 1} other campus${d.campuses > 2 ? "es" : ""}` : d.name})))
BANDS = FileAttachment("../data/bands.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

::: {.cs-lead}
Search for a college to see its faculty and non-faculty staff per 1,000 students, enrollment and spending per student, year by year, against the **middle half of its sector** (the 25th to 75th percentile of every college in the sector reporting that year). The cards give its own FY2013–24 decomposition: how much of any change in staff per student came from staff and how much from students.
:::

::: {.cs-links}
Read more: [white paper §4](../paper/index.qmd#sec-4) (staffing and spending since 2012) and [§7](../paper/index.qmd#sec-7) (research and medical centers). Substack posts: Post 1 and Post 4 (links on publication).
:::

```{ojs}
viewof secF = Inputs.select(["all", ...SECTORS.map(s => s.k)], {format: k => k === "all" ? "All sectors" : SECL[k], value: param("sector", "all"), label: "Sector"})
viewof stF = Inputs.select(["all", ...STLIST], {format: s => s === "all" ? "All states" : STNAME[s], value: param("st", "all"), label: "State"})
viewof q = Inputs.search(IDX.filter(d => (secF === "all" || d.sec === secF) && (stF === "all" || d.st === stF)), {placeholder: "Search by name, e.g. Purdue", label: "Search"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof pick = Inputs.table(q, {
  columns: ["label", "st", "sec", "fte24", "d_fte", "d_facfte_r", "d_nonfacfte_r"],
  header: {label: "Institution", st: "State", sec: "Sector", fte24: "Fall FTE FY2024", d_fte: "FTE FY13→24", d_facfte_r: "Faculty FTE per student FY13→24", d_nonfacfte_r: "Non-faculty FTE per student FY13→24"},
  format: {sec: k => SECL[k], fte24: f0, d_fte: s1, d_facfte_r: s1, d_nonfacfte_r: s1},
  width: {label: 300}, layout: "auto",
  sort: "fte24", reverse: true, rows: 8, multiple: false,
  value: q.find(d => String(d.id) === param("id", "243780")) ?? d3.greatest(q, d => d.fte24 ?? 0)
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
P = pick ? d3.csv(`../data/inst/${pick.st}.csv`, d3.autoType) : []
I = pick ? P.filter(d => d.id === pick.id) : []
syncI = { if (pick) setParam("id", pick.id); setParam("sector", secF === "all" ? null : secF); setParam("st", stF === "all" ? null : stF); return true; }
band = (m) => pick ? BANDS.filter(d => d.sec === pick.sec && d.m === m) : []
```

```{ojs}
viewof im = measSelect(IMEAS.map(d => d.k), {value: param("m", "pair"), label: "Staff measure", L: IMEASL})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
bandChart = (m, {w, h = 280, title, fmt = f0, ylab, era: useEra = false}) => {
  // m may be one column or an array (the faculty / non-faculty pair: solid / dashed, each with its sector band)
  const ms = Array.isArray(m) ? m : [m];
  const me = ms.flatMap(c => I.filter(d => d[c] != null && isFinite(d[c])).map(d => ({...d, c, v: d[c], e: c + (useEra || IBRK.has(c) ? era(d.fy) : "a")})));
  const b = ms.flatMap(c => band(c).map(d => ({...d, c, e: c + (useEra || IBRK.has(c) ? era(d.fy) : "a")})));
  if (!me.length) return html`<div style="width:${w}px"><h4 style="font-size:1rem;margin:.3rem 0">${title}</h4><p class="cs-note">No data reported for this institution.</p></div>`;
  const brk = useEra || ms.some(c => IBRK.has(c));
  const x0 = d3.min(me, d => d.fy) - 1;
  const bb = b.filter(d => d.fy >= x0);
  const dash = c => ms.length > 1 && c === "nfte" ? "5,3" : null;
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: h, marginLeft: 52, marginTop: 28, marginRight: ms.length > 1 ? 70 : 20, title,
    x: {...yearAxis, domain: [x0, 2026]}, y: {grid: true, label: ylab, tickFormat: fmt === usd ? "$,.0f" : null},
    marks: [
      brk ? Plot.ruleX([2012.5], {stroke: BREAKC, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}) : null,
      Plot.areaY(bb, {x: "fy", y1: "p25", y2: "p75", z: "e", fill: SECC[pick.sec], fillOpacity: 0.15}),
      Plot.lineY(bb, {x: "fy", y: "p50", z: "e", stroke: SECC[pick.sec], strokeDasharray: "2,3", strokeWidth: 1.1}),
      ...ms.map(c => Plot.lineY(me.filter(d => d.c === c), {x: "fy", y: "v", z: "e", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.2, strokeDasharray: dash(c)})),
      Plot.dot(me, {x: "fy", y: "v", r: 2.5, fill: INK}),
      ms.length > 1 ? Plot.text(ms.map(c => me.filter(d => d.c === c).at(-1)).filter(Boolean), {x: "fy", y: "v", text: d => d.c === "ffte" ? "Faculty" : "Non-faculty", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}) : null,
      Plot.tip(me, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => { const s = b.find(x => x.fy === d.fy && x.c === d.c); return `${ms.length > 1 ? IMEASL[d.c] + "\n" : ""}FY${d.fy}: ${fmt(d.v)}${s ? `\nsector median ${fmt(s.p50)} (middle half ${fmt(s.p25)}–${fmt(s.p75)})` : ""}`; }}))
    ]
  });
}
```

```

pick ? bandChart("fte", {w: half(width), title: "Fall FTE students", fmt: f0, ylab: null}) : html``
```

</div>

::: {.cs-note}
Black line: this institution (in the default view, faculty FTE solid and non-faculty FTE dashed). Shaded band: middle half of its sector; dotted line: sector median (all institutions in the sector reporting that year, not only surviving ones). FTE staff = full-time + one-third of part-time; faculty excludes graduate assistants, shown as their own measure. Red dashed line: the FY2012|FY2013 IPEDS staff-survey redesign. Part-time faculty, graduate assistants and the part-time share are spliced there, EAM, professional and nonprofessional staff were reclassified, and the v1 headcounts contain the spliced series, so those measures are drawn as separate segments. Faculty FTE, non-faculty FTE and full-time faculty are continuous at the median institution; community-college non-faculty FTE steps up about 1 log point (part-time staff) in FY2013.
:::

### Spending per student

```{ojs}
viewof fm = Inputs.select(new Map([["Instruction", "ins"], ["Academic support", "acs"], ["Student services", "sts"], ["Institutional support", "iss"], ["Auxiliary enterprises (housing, dining, etc.)", "aux"]]), {value: param("f", "ins"), label: "Function"})
```

<div class="cs-two">

```{ojs}
pick ? bandChart(fm, {w: half(width), title: `${new Map([["ins","Instruction"],["acs","Academic support"],["sts","Student services"],["iss","Institutional support"],["aux","Auxiliary enterprises"]]).get(fm)} per FTE student (real 2024 $)`, fmt: usd, ylab: null}) : html``
```

```{ojs}
pick ? bandChart("ath", {w: half(width), title: "Athletics spending per FTE student (real 2024 $)", fmt: usd, ylab: null}) : html``
```

</div>

```{ojs}
{
  if (!pick || !I.length) return html``;
  const F = [["ins", "Instruction"], ["acs", "Academic support"], ["sts", "Student services"], ["iss", "Institutional support"], ["aux", "Auxiliary enterprises"], ["ath", "Athletics (EADA)"]];
  const at = (fy, m) => I.find(d => d.fy === fy)?.[m];
  const med = (fy, m) => band(m).find(d => d.fy === fy)?.p50;
  const y0 = 2013, y1 = 2024;
  return html`<div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Per FTE student, real 2024 $</th><th>FY${y0}</th><th>FY${y1}</th><th>Change</th><th>Sector median FY${y1}</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${F.map(([m, l]) => { const a = at(y0, m), b = at(y1, m); return html`<tr><td>${l}</td><td>${usd(a)}</td><td>${usd(b)}</td><td>${a > 0 && b > 0 ? s0(100 * Math.log(b / a)) + " log pts" : "–"}</td><td>${usd(med(y1, m))}</td></tr>`; })}
  </tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
**Data.** Staff: IPEDS Human Resources (FY *t* = fall *t*−1); students: fall FTE enrollment. Institutions are Delta Cost extension groups: campuses that merged, or that a Delta Cost-era system reported together, are one unit for every year. Spending: IPEDS Finance by function, real 2024 dollars (CPI-U fiscal year), hospital expenses excluded, FY2004 onward (even years before FY2012). Athletics: Equity in Athletics (EADA) total athletic expense, FY2007–2024. FY2024–25 IPEDS values are NCES provisional. Staff per student changes are in log points ×100 (about percent for small changes), FY2013→24 so that every change lies within the redesigned staff survey.
:::

{ syncI; setParam("m", im === "pair" ? null : im); setParam("f", fm === "ins" ? null : fm); return 1; }
